narrative: Material PL3__M8E7DBB2 exhibits intermittent demand with 76.3% non-zero days and moderate variability (CV=0.33). Lead time is highly unstable (CV=1.16) with mean 0.75 days, requiring a safety stock of 471 units to achieve 95% service level. The EOQ-based order quantity of 1,677 units optimally balances ordering and holding costs while staying within storage capacity. The recommended policy increases annual costs by 28% compared to zero-safety-stock baseline, but ensures reliable service despite lead time volatility.
